uncited: - **Input:** A pre-trained 3DGS model (set of Gaussians with position, covariance, opacity, and spherical harmonic coefficients) generated by a feed-forward model (e.g., LGM, MVSplat).
**Attribute Extraction:** Extract all Gaussian attributes from the feed-forward model.
**Masking for Feed-Forward Models:** When compressing 3DGS from feed-forward models, set the mask $m$ for color attributes to all 0s.
**Entropy Model Application:** Apply the Memory-Efficient Memory (MEM) module and context models to compress the remaining attributes (position, rotation, scale, opacity).
**Bitstream Generation:** Encode the quantized and context-predicted attributes into a bitstream using an entropy coder (e.g., arithmetic coding).
It addresses the need for efficient compression of 3DGS models generated by feed-forward networks, which are increasingly popular for rapid 3D reconstruction.
